verdicts.reason: Both separate the can from its lavender circle, leaving the circle cropped against the right edge as a stray, empty blob. Both also shrink the can until its SOLSTICE label can't be read. In A, the subtitle stays readable and the NEW VIDEO badge sits apart below it, but the badge is tiny and floats loosely under the text block. B is worse: the subtitle is shrunk to near-illegible size, and the cramped NEWVIDEO badge butts into the end of 'favourite.', which is a collision.
